item.title: Wrexham v Millwall match gallery
item.description: Millwall were 2-0 winners at Wrexham in the Sky Bet Championship on Saturday afternoon. The best of the action from SToK Rae Cas can be seen below as a Max Cleworth own-goal and Josh Coburn's hit give The Lions three priceless points on the road.

item.title: A vital clean sheet for Coops and Millwall
item.description: A monstrous defensive performance at SToK Rae Cas. Alongside Caleb Taylor, Jake Cooper kept Wrexham quiet in Saturday's 2-0 win in North Wales - and The Lions' captain spoke to Millwall TV+ after the victory, with his post-match interview now available below. Click play to hear from Coops as he praises the travelling fans and more.

item.title: Lions receive five London Football Awards nominations
item.description: Millwall Football Club and Millwall Community Trust have received five nominations at this year's London Football Awards. The London Football Awards, proudly supported by MiQ, have been celebrating the best of London football for more than 10 years and are independently judged by senior figures from across the industry. item.title: Fly On The Wall | Winning in Wrexham
item.description: Three vital points on the road. Millwall beat Wrexham 2-0 at SToK Cae Ras on Saturday afternoon, courtesy of an own-goal and Josh Coburn's thumping strike. Go behind-the-scenes in North Wales now in the latest episode of 'Fly On The Wall' below!

item.title: Foursome Lionesses beat Benfica
item.description: Millwall Lionesses were 4-0 winners over Sport London E Benfica on Sunday afternoon. It took until the 66th minute for the scoring to be opened through Maisie Joyce, but the floodgates then opened as Ted Jones' side added to their lead courtesy of strikes from Liva Helt, Joyce again and Kayda Townsend. item.title: Wright on target as Under 18s win at Brentford
item.description: Millwall's Under 18s were 1-0 winners at Brentford on Saturday. Will Wright notched the only goal at Wheatsheaf Park as Chris Perry's side picked up three Professional Development League points. The Under 18s currently sit sixth in the Southern Section, with Cardiff City the next visitors to Calmont Road this Saturday.FixturesBrentford U18 Vs. Millwall U18 - Sat, Feb 07 2026, 11:30

item.title: Lions duo visit Haberdashers Knights Academy
item.description: Millwall First-Team duo Jake Cooper and Massimo Luongo visited Haberdashers Knights Academy as part of Premier League Inspires. Millwall Community Trust’s Premier League Inspires programme works with schools across Lewisham and Southwark to give young people an empowering and positive experience. Each session is designed to encourage students to reflect, set goals, and build the skills they need for the future. item.title: Postponements and injuries hamper Lions loanees
